scenarios.name: health-recovers-by-itself
scenarios.behavior: Fails two health reads in a row with HTTP 503 and waits for the panel to show the services without pressing Retry.
scenarios.expectation: HLT-2 in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md: a failed health read is retried after 1, 2 and 4 seconds, and the panel shows the services when a retry succeeds.
scenarios.limits: Two HTTP 503 failures on page load; not the message after the last retry, or other fault kinds.

scenarios.name: notifications-empty-state
scenarios.behavior: Loads the board for an account without notifications, fails the notifications read and presses its Retry.
scenarios.expectation: NTF-2 in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md: an account with no notifications sees "You're all caught up"; a failed read offers Retry.
scenarios.limits: The signed-in account only; a list of notifications is not checked.
